description: The rib-cast-on-unknown-flat chart with 26 stitches cast on. Row 1 repeats its 4-stitch motif to the last stitch over the cast-on: 26 less the two edge stitches leaves 24, so the motif is worked 6 times, and row 2 works the same 26. The written instructions start with the cast-on, and validation is clean.
covers: ToEnd on the first row resolved by the cast-on

rows.written: Row 1 (RS): k, *k2, p2; rep from * to last st, k
Row 2 (WS): p, *k2, p2; rep from * to last st, p
